page.layout: One page, a digitiser's cover sheet: e-rara logo at top right, title block centred, rules and terms-of-use paragraphs below. No printed text of the book.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the printed book. It gives the e-rara logo, the site address, the bibliographic record (Calvin, Jean, Joannis Calvini ... epistolarum et responsorum editio secunda, Lausannae, 1576; Bibliothèque de Genève, shelf marks BGE Ctb 4887, BGE Bf 1149; persistent link https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-5849), multilingual terms of use and the Visual Library logo. All of this is left out as digitiser matter.
